review.rationale: Reviewed selected Challenge statements, alignment accounts and decoded project.description. Supporting lemmas are grouped with their mathematical result; separate result families and selected boundary results have explicit abstract phrases. This is an agent review, not independent human or Palomar editorial clearance.

families.account: One-bus and many-bus critical-family cardinalities have the displayed exact exponential values.
Every universal physical test list has at least the critical-family cardinality.
Deterministic and finite randomized adaptive query models obey the displayed critical-family bounds.
